title: CREDITS AND XP ONLY WHERE THEY ARE SPENT
why: His note after playing: the UI is not as clean as it should be. In the pictures, the credits and XP readout in the top right corner sat on every screen, over the title, the run cards, the pause box and the party DEMO pages, and on the frame line of the welcome pack, the map select screen and Settings, where the numbers mean nothing. It is hidden on those now and stays on the Undercroft floor, the stash and the shop, craft, hire, Wirt, bar, Mainframe and Fashion windows. In a raid it is left to the HUD.
now: Credits and XP show only on the screens where you spend them.
